title: Point voice transcription at your own ASR service
description:
The stream connector already honours VOICE_STREAM_BASE_URL, but refuses to connect at all without an OAuth token and always sends that token as the bearer — so the override cannot reach a service that is not Anthropic's. This makes both conditional on the override being set.

The wire protocol is Deepgram-compatible: linear16 PCM at 16 kHz mono, with encoding, sample_rate, channels, endpointing_ms, utterance_end_ms and language as query parameters. Any server speaking that will do.

  VOICE_STREAM_BASE_URL=ws://127.0.0.1:8080
  VOICE_STREAM_TOKEN=<optional bearer for your service>

sites.description:
`if(!cred?.accessToken) return log(...), null` — the early bail that makes an OAuth session mandatory. Relaxed only when the override is set, so the stock path keeps requiring a token exactly as before.

Matched through its own log message rather than the token shape, since `!x?.accessToken` is a common enough test.

The Authorization header. A self-hosted service has no reason to accept an Anthropic token, and may want none at all — hence the empty-string fallback rather than passing undefined, which would make the header read "Bearer undefined".

verify.describe: bearer is overridable for a self-hosted service
the override lifts the OAuth requirement
